purpose: A floating menu of three or more secondary commands opened from a Button or IconButton, with optional search, labelled groups and a footer. Destructive commands go last.

notFor.case: Choosing a value for a form field.
One or two actions that fit on screen.
Rich, non-command content in a floating panel.

open.visual: A Surface/layer-2 panel with a Border/default stroke and Border/subtle separators; it enters with popover-enter.

closed.meaning: Hidden; focus is back on the trigger.
closed.visual: Not shown; it leaves with popover-exit.

a11y.keyboard: Space / Enter / ArrowDown on the trigger open it and focus the first item; ArrowDown / ArrowUp move between items (wrapping); Home / End jump to the first / last; Enter / Space activate the focused item and close; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; A–Z typeahead (Radix DropdownMenu).
notes: The trigger keeps aria-expanded in sync.
Keep the footer outside the menu role; its controls are reached with Tab after the list.
Size cascades to every label, item and the footer.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the menu appear and leave with no popover-enter / popover-exit animation, or with a fade only?
